GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Held Ground midrace until pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in @ 250m. Ran on soundly in last 150m. # Wide/OK late.

Shade slow away. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken on inside @ 400m. Pushed along Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pushed back in Two Wide @ 300m & pressured @ 250m. Faded in last 100m. # didn't finish off
Jumped Ok well back 800m 2nd last 3 Wide laid out 5 Lengths home turn 5th 7 Lengths Hooked Out Straight to hold ground # back/held position
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out when racing wide and without cover in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (4L from lead). Stayed @ rear on inside midrace & pushed to quicken on inside (3L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along @ 300m & pressured @ 250m. Outgunned on rail in last 200m. # didn't finish off
Jumped Ok Drifted Back Settled Down 2nd last 9 Lengths off Tearaway Leader Fast Pace on, went 8 Wide Soon After Straightening Up Kept Coming Closest on line, Sound # via car park

Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield on inside (6L from lead). Stayed same until pusheed to quicken @ 400m & laid out 3 Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 300m & held ground in last 200m. # Even effort.

Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to chase Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in Four Wide @ 300m. Held ground in last 200m. # Wide/stuck on OK.
Jumped Ok Settled Down Inside Mid Field 4l. Ridden Along Turn . Saved Ground into Straight 3l away. railed Through to 100m but denied run there and went to line untested # no luck in straight
